{{Quote|A cold-blooded, emotionless sand snake if I ever saw one, but when he heard about Grunta's death, he nearly smiled. Nothing would make him happier than beating Nal Kenuun.|Haari Ikreme Beeerd on Chenik Kruun|<ref name="Target" />}}
'''Chenik Kruun''' was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. He was the employer of the [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Gilag Pitaaani]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Kruun entered Pitaaani on a [[Muunilinst Podrace|podrace]] believing he would finally beat his longtime rival [[Nal Kenuun]], whose podracer [[Grunta]] [[Death/Legends|died]] a few days before the race. The race was won by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who took Grunta's place as part of a deal he negotiated with Kenuun.<ref name="Target" />

Kruun was described by [[Haari Ikreme Beeerd]]&mdash;one of the crewmen on his employ&mdash;as cold-blooded and emotionless.<ref name="Target" />
